articleParts.text: The Weapon Editor allows you to create and configure '.wpn' files, which define the visual and technical parameters of ship weapons.

1. Turret and Hardpoint Sprites: Weapons can have different sprites depending on whether they are mounted on a Turret slot or a Hardpoint slot. You can define a base sprite, a glow sprite (for energy weapons or engine exhausts on missiles), and an under-sprite for both mount types.
2. Center Point: Make sure to accurately set the weapon's center point. This determines the pivot around which the weapon rotates to track targets.
Firing offsets determine exactly where projectiles or beams spawn when the weapon fires.
1. In the Offsets instrument tab, you can click in the viewport to add new firing points, such as the tips of multiple gun barrels.
2. For weapons with multiple barrels, you can add multiple offsets. The weapon will cycle through these offsets when firing according to its defined behavior.
Many weapons, such as chainguns or charging energy weapons, use sprite sheets to animate.
1. Animation Type: Specify how the weapon animates (e.g., NONE, GLOW, MUZZLE_FLASH, ANIMATED_WEAPON).
2. Frame Rate: Set the framerate at which the animation plays.
3. Number of Frames: If using a sprite sheet, define how many frames it contains so the editor and game know how to split the image.
